# Gaussian splat viewer

Served by the Workspace itself, so a page showing a Gaussian splat (`.splat`, `.ksplat` or a PLY of splats) makes no request to a third party. It is loaded only on a page that shows one, with three.js from `public/vendor/three` by an import map. Copied from Heratio (`public/vendor/gaussian-splats-3d`), roadmap phase 21.
